charts.question: Failures warned before the event
charts.supported_finding: Each drive and failure date counts once even with repeat warnings.
charts.interpretation_boundary: A recorded hardware failure is a proxy for replacement need. A late and an absent failure are distinguishable only while the drive remains observed. Alternative dispatch rules are replayed on logged outcomes.

charts.question: Confirmed false alert episodes
charts.supported_finding: A consecutive episode with incomplete follow-up is reported as unresolved unless a failure is observed.
